findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/managed-host-run-smoke.ts:205-252 — CHK-001:edge:0 is mapped only to this receipt, but its silent case uses an injected in-process runner, waits 30 ms once, and advances only a diagnostic clock. The real child-process continuation invoked by this smoke delays 600 ms at managed-host-run-e2e-smoke.ts:138-153. It does not keep a real provider silent beyond the legacy observation boundary or exercise repeated next-touch calls, so the must intent lacks corresponding mechanical evidence.

packages/main/src/tasks/cross-host-review-smoke.ts:329-452 — the receipt mapped to CHK-005:adversarial:0 checks managed submission, absence of a direct spawn/kill stack, ordinary detach/resume, and sealed-output tampering, but never supplies caller-controlled command, cwd, environment, output path, or verdict binding values. A regression forwarding one of those inputs into the privileged ManagedHostRun profile would not be exercised by the cited test, so the required bypass matrix is missing.

Fresh lattice validate --json returned allPass=false. review-pass-discard-smoke.ts:177-190, reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke.ts:492-513, and quorum-submit-smoke.ts:289-320 all fail at the new direct-review authority boundary because their native reviewer fixtures do not establish trusted broker provenance. This contradicts CHK-006:edge:3's compatibility claim that native-host reviewer lanes retain their existing signed pass/finding path; the focused managed-review smoke's constructed broker control does not make the integrated validation suite pass.

Fresh lattice validate --json also fails retired-authority-vocabulary-guard-smoke.ts:4852 because the registered AST fingerprint for the unchanged cli-engine.ts:808-809 non-literal cli-init loader no longer matches after this story's cli-engine changes. The story's evidence set contains no passing full-validation receipt that detects this integration regression.
